title: scope_approval — an operating licence over a condition range (6.1)

config.description: the one configuration this licence covers

range.description: must be a subset of the envelope; it can never exceed it (6.1, check 18)

example_judged_at.description: For a committed example under contracts/examples/ only: the instant check 19 judges valid_until against, in place of the wall clock, so an example cannot expire by the clock and refuse every commit, as one did at 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z. Without it an example is judged at its approved_at. A real permit is always judged by the wall clock, and one carrying this field is refused. The person allowed this on 2026-10-17 (HP-007).

calibration_refs.description: the licence dies when any of these is superseded or expires

max_grade.description: a scope may only cover plans resting on E1-E3 (6.1)

reason.description: the first five are the conditions code detects (6.1); ended_by_person is the person withdrawing the permit by choice, which needs no condition and names who

by.description: who ended it; required when the reason is ended_by_person
